seoTitle: Break-Even Selling Price Calculator for Products
metaDescription: Find the lowest price that covers product cost, packaging, shipping, fees and ads, with an optional target profit. Free and private.
intro: Finds the price at which an order covers product cost, packaging, shipping, ads and percentage fees, and the price needed for a profit you choose.
why:
A price that looks fine can lose money once fees that scale with the price are counted. Fixed costs are simple to add, but a percentage fee is taken from the price itself, so the formula divides by one minus the fee rate rather than adding a percentage on top.

Enter your costs per order and any target profit. The tool shows the break-even price and the price for your target, and checks the result by working the profit back.
howTo: Enter product, packaging and shipping costs.
Enter ad cost per order, the percentage fees and the fixed fee per order.
Optionally set a target profit per order and read the price.

faq.q: Why not just add the fee percent to the cost?
faq.a: Because the fee is a share of the final price. Adding 12 percent of cost undercharges. The tool divides by (1 - fee%) instead.
Add an average cost per order into ad cost or product cost if you want to spread it. The tool has no separate returns field.

faq.q: Is the margin shown on price or cost?
faq.a: On price. It is profit divided by the selling price.
